name: Hippoo mobile app for woocommerce
author: Hippoo Team

sections.description:
Hippoo WooCommerce App | Your Store, Anywhere, Anytime

The Hippoo WooCommerce app is a powerful extension that enhances the functionality of your WooCommerce shop. Seamlessly integrate your shop with the Hippoo Android app to unlock advanced features, including the creation of out-of-stock lists, adding images to order products via API, and user authentication for optimal app utilization. Take control of your shop’s inventory, order fulfillment, and customer engagement with ease.

Key Features:

  1. Advanced Sales Analytics: Track revenue, top-selling products, and trends with a custom date range for deeper insights.
  2. Extensive Add-ons & Integrations: Enhance functionality with powerful add-ons and third-party integrations.
  3. Create & Edit Orders/Products: Customize orders and products with advanced options, including pricing, variations, and attributes.
  4. WordPress Media Gallery Access: Upload, delete, and share media directly from your WooCommerce store.
  5. Team Collaboration & Order Sharing: Share or duplicate orders easily with your team to improve efficiency.
  6. Out-of-Stock List: Monitor low-stock and out-of-stock products to restock efficiently and prevent missed sales.
  7. Order Product Image API: Enhance order management with product images for better fulfillment and customer satisfaction.
  8. User Authentication: Securely authenticate users for advanced store management features.
  9. Invoice & Shipping Label Creation: Generate and customize invoices and shipping labels with automatic order details.
  10. Barcode Generation: Display and print barcodes for product SKUs and order IDs. Quickly find orders and products by scanning barcodes.
  11. Instant Order Notifications: Get notified the moment you receive a new order or when a product goes out of stock.
  12. Multi-Shop Management: Add and manage multiple WooCommerce stores for free—all in one app!
  13. Hundreds More Features: Enjoy a comprehensive toolset with exclusive WooCommerce management features you won’t find in other apps!

To install the Hippoo WooCommerce app on your phone:

  1. Visit the Google Play Store using the following link: Hippoo Android App.
  2. Click on the “Install” button to download and install the Hippoo app on your Android device.
  3. Open the Hippoo app and follow the on-screen instructions to authenticate your shop and start utilizing the advanced features.

Short Description

Manage your WooCommerce store on the go with Hippoo. Get real-time order notifications, manage inventory, and track sales—all from your mobile device.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Install Hippo WooCommerce app (Android) or Hippoo WooCommerce app for iOS
sections.changelog:
• 1.5.0 – Improvements & Enhancements Enhanced app functionality for a smoother user experience. Improved plugin authentication system, allowing seamless integration with third-party plugins. Optimized performance and security for better reliability.
  • 1.4.3 – Updated the mobile notification text and title, Round the weight on orders
  • 1.4.2 – Added invoice and shipping label creation, SKU barcode on product pages, and order ID barcode on order pages.
  • 1.3.5 – Change the “Tested up to” value
  • 1.3.4 – Add weight to order object
  • 1.3.3 – Fix config UI and minor changes
  • 1.3.2 – Handle remote json fetch failure
  • Add product images to orders
  • Add out-of-stock API
  • Hippoo app auth
